lines.text: The ford is low enough to cross. Whoever has been raiding the valley came through here, and did not bother to hide it.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: Tracks on the far bank. Two days old, and heavy — they were carrying somebody's winter out.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Then we follow them. The pass first.

lines.speaker: Toln
lines.text: A whole raiding band, and this many of us. I'd like the record to show I said that out loud.
